summary: ServisFirst Bancshares filed a routine Form 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.19 per share at a September 21, 2026 meeting. The dividend is payable October 9, 2026, to shareholders of record as of October 1, 2026. No advisor, premium, stake, or structural/regulatory mechanics are involved. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration by the bank holding company, not a special situation; no deal terms, tender, or change-of-control event are present, and no risk-arb angle applies.
